default_delivery.description: Default delivery directory (Maildir or Mbox path). Use quotes for paths with spaces.

logfile.description: Path to maildrop log file. Empty string disables logging.

quota_mb.description: Maximum mailbox size in megabytes (only used if quota_enabled=true).

maxsize.description: Maximum message size in bytes. 0 = no limit. Recommend 25000000 (25MB) for modern use.

ext_filter_enabled.description: Enable extended Sieve-like filtering (e.g., using Dovecot's managedsieve).

sieve_script.description: Path to Sieve script for extended filtering (only used if ext_filter_enabled=true).

filter_rules.description: List of filter rules. Each rule may have a condition (omit for unconditional) and an action.

pre_delivery_hook.description: Command to run before final delivery (e.g., antivirus scan). Must be quoted and safe.
